correctness.summary: A dihedral reduction and explicit two-piece boundary construction cover the N congruent to 4 and 8 modulo 12 cases. On each piece, all three difference vectors remain in fixed polygonal cones while their derivatives are tangent to the corresponding unit-sphere edges, so the polygonal gauge is constant. Endpoint reflections force the three constant side lengths to coincide. The known N=4, N=8, and 12-divisible cases complete every N divisible by 4.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2025 perimeter paper explicitly leaves H_16 and H_32 as numerical questions. The 2026 pi/6-rotation theorem covers regular N-gons only when 12 divides N. Searches for H_16/H_32, regular 4n-gonal norms, constant equilateral perimeter, L_3=M_3, and equivalent Jung-constant formulations found no theorem covering the two remaining residue classes or a stronger result implying them.

value.summary: The result settles the H_16 and H_32 conjectures and proves the full regular-4n family, with exact trigonometric formulas for the common perimeter in the previously uncovered residue classes.

limitations: The result is specific to regular polygonal unit spheres and does not characterize all normed planes with L_3=M_3.
Originality remains subject to residual risk from unindexed, inaccessible, or differently phrased literature.
The numerical verification artifact is supplementary and does not replace the analytic proof.
